name: remote-debug-agent
description: Safe remote Linux debugging through a local SSH-backed agent.

interface.shortDescription: Debug Linux servers through a safe local SSH agent
interface.longDescription: Remote Debug Agent lets Codex inspect approved paths and run whitelisted diagnostic commands on a remote Linux server through a local Node agent. It provides categorized, paginated system, Nginx, application, and PM2 log discovery, bounded recent-line reads with substring filtering, and streaming reads from gzip and tar-gzip log archives without remote extraction. It also provides bounded read-only MongoDB queries plus explicitly enabled, allowlisted MongoDB document and index mutation plans with transaction or compensating rollback journals. One-time command drafts remain available for reviewed maintenance commands, while the local agent enforces command allowlists, path boundaries, SSH configuration, compression and archive limits, mutation scopes, BSON/update limits, temporary journal permissions, timeouts, one-time hashes, model-review bounds, and audit logging. Version 2.2.0 adds opt-in resumable MongoDB bulk changes across allowlisted collections, with transactional batch receipts, verification and guarded rollback.
defaultPrompt: List and read compressed application logs safely
Prepare and roll back a bounded MongoDB change
Prepare and roll back a resumable MongoDB bulk job
